standard_prerequisites.name: Pairs of generating sections represent projective space
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the invertible sheaf L and its generating sections into the morphism varphi.

standard_prerequisites.name: Closed immersions local on the target
standard_prerequisites.use: Chartwise surjectivity of the ring maps gives a closed immersion.

core_obligations: Reduce to S = Spec(Z); take L = pr_1^*O(1) tensor pr_2^*O(1) with the (n+1)(m+1) sections X_i Y_j, which generate L.
The morphism varphi has varphi^{-1}(D_+(Z_{i + (n+1) j})) = D_+(X_i) times D_+(Y_j), so it is affine.
On the (0,0) chart the ring map sends Z_i/Z_0 and Z_{(n+1)j}/Z_0 to the coordinate fractions and is surjective; conclude closed immersion.
proof_roadmap: Build L and the sections, check generation, compute the chart preimages and one chart ring map, then close by the local criterion with the mirror argument for the other charts.
difficulty_reason: Representability input gives the morphism; closed immersion via affine charts and a displayed surjective ring map; the remaining charts are mirror-level.
